name: Me And The Boys
look: A cartoon still of four Spider-Man villains grinning mischievously side by side on a peach background: the Rhino in his gray horned suit, the Vulture with a white feather collar, Electro in his yellow lightning mask, and the Green Goblin. Blank white space sits above them.
use: Shows a group of friends teaming up for something silly or chaotic. The caption usually starts with me and the boys and describes the dumb plan or shared moment.
slots: me and the boys doing something (caption above)
examples: Me and the boys at 2 a.m. heading to the kitchen for snacks
Me and the boys after hearing there's free pizza in the break room
